entities.summary: Mykola Lukash was a well-known Ukrainian literary translator, theorist, and lexicographer who was born in Krolevets and died in Kyiv. He knew more than 20 languages. Many literary works were successfully translated from the majority of these languages and introduced to the Ukrainian literature by him.
